scope.positioning: API flag parity covers migration-critical goctl api go and api format flags without claiming a full goctl formatter clone.
scope.referenceFramework: goctl api go --test, goctl api go --type-group, goctl api format --stdin, and goctl api format --declare

compatibilityPolicy.apiGoTest: The --test flag must generate route or handler smoke tests that compile in generated projects.
compatibilityPolicy.apiGoTypeGroup: The --type-group flag must split DTOs into per-type files and avoid writing a monolithic types.go for grouped output.
compatibilityPolicy.apiFormatStdin: The --stdin flag must read API content from standard input and emit formatted content to stdout or the requested output file.
compatibilityPolicy.apiFormatDeclare: The --declare flag is accepted for goctl migration compatibility; formatter semantic parity remains bounded by ParseAPI and FormatAPI behavior until an oracle fixture is pinned.

apiSurfaces.goflySurface: gofly api go --test / gofly api gen --test
apiSurfaces.behavior: generates route test files for generated REST services

apiSurfaces.goflySurface: gofly api go --type-group / gofly api gen --type-group
apiSurfaces.behavior: writes per-message type files and suppresses monolithic types.go
reads API source from stdin and writes formatted output to stdout or --output
accepts the flag without changing output claims until declare-specific oracle coverage exists

nextPromotionCriteria: Promote api-format-declare from compat-accepted to implemented only after a real goctl formatter oracle fixture proves declare-specific behavior.
Keep --test and --type-group promoted only while generated route tests and split type files are covered by command and generator tests.
Do not describe API flag support as full goctl parity unless every requiredFlag has implemented status and a runnable gate.
